notes.title: To celebrate the launch of Super Drift Blade, all my works are discounted.
notes.content:
Dear players:

My new game, "Super Drift Blade," is now online! Come support us! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2847740/
Quick Start Guide for "Super Drift Blade"! 


This game is quite complex, not a simple roguelike.
We recommend playing in windowed mode. Switching screens may cause icon errors; if you encounter this, please restart the game. (This is a GameMaker bug that I haven't fixed yet.)
If you think it's good, please leave a review on Steam. Your review means a lot to me! Thank you, boss!
I'm not being sympathetic, nor am I being sympathetic. Just being able to make a game, get it made, have people play it, and sell it is a huge win! I'm just worried I won't connect with the players (again, play the demo first).
 Remember to claim your free OST.


Meanwhile, all my other games are on sale!

notes.title: Welcome to FOLLOW "Treasure Drifter: Nian", my new game in development!
notes.content:
Welcome to "Treasure Drifter: Nian", my new game in development!

Feel free to add my new game to your wish list, the support of players is very important to me.

It's been a long time since I've made an announcement, and I'd like to thank the players of "Beats Warrior: Nian" for their tolerance of the game. This is my first work online on Steam. Solo development has given me a lot of experience, so I made a second game, and I hope you will enjoy it and witness my progress.


Meanwhile.
Feel free to add my new game to your wish list, the support of players is very important to me. 2021 the game will be ready to meet players! 

Steam store: Steam page. 

The game content is not very rich, has been developed one after another for more than 1 year, and the type of gameplay is not in the "Beats Warrior: Nian" kind of rhythm cross-board combat class.  It's a bit of a strange cross-board action game now.

The current promotional video, video content in addition to some text narrative, are recorded live. A new promo video will be edited later.

[previewyoutube=bq7hXOVF_CY;full][/previewyoutube]
Game (current) synopsis: Treasure Drifter: Nian is a combination of stationary defensive action and walking exploration.  Take your partner on a long journey to learn different character stories, defeat difficult enemies, and unlock different organs and puzzles. Keep growing and exploring the world in the cycle of advancing and returning.


The game is still in development, so perhaps it will change more in the future due to gradual polishing, new content and changes.




2020.12.22

Liujiajun

notes.title: Beat Warrior: Nian 1.05 Patch Notes: Stronger UI Feedback
notes.content:
According to the player feedback, and self-examination, the game is updated and repaired again. The main update is UI feedback for enhanced rhythm.

Release Notes:
1. Fix the bug that the player pauses after the player returns to the camp.
2. Enhanced game combat UI effects. The feedback of the rhythm becomes stronger.
3. Optimized the battle music of the game, making the rhythm more stable.
4. Temporarily disable the highest speed mode and fix it in future versions.


July 25, 2019

notes.title: Beat Warrior: Nian 1.04 Patch Notes: Music update
notes.content:
For some reason players can not hear the BOSS battle music, it has been fixed.

Patch Notes:
1. Added new tracks to the main battle music.
2. Replaced the fighting music of the Great Sword Ninja Chicken.
3. Replaced the battle music of King Gamu XVI.
4. Replaced the battle music of Rock Witch.
5, Replaced the battle music of Sleepy Seal.
6, Replaced the ghost music of The Claw.

If you have any other questions, please leave a message or contact me :)


July 22, 2019

notes.title: Beat Warrior: Nian 1.03 Patch Notes: Checkpoint added
notes.content:
The game was further updated for feedback from players.

Release Notes:
1. Checkpoint is added before each BOSS.
2. The tutorial level is optimized again.
3. There is a fruit that can healing the HP in each level now.


July 20, 2019

notes.title: Beat Warrior: Nian 1.02 Patch Notes: Difficulty Adjustment
notes.content:
For the feedback of the players, the game has been slightly modified and updated, reducing the difficulty :)

Release Notes:
1. The tutorial has become more direct and obvious, and it doesn't matter if you miss the tutorial book on the ground.
2. Affected by the weather, there is a fruit in the forest that can Healing the HP!
3. Fix the full screen problem again!
4. Once again, increase the time for operation judgment!
5. Now, when you pause, press Back to go back directly to the game.
6. Fix the text error, change the clearance screen "PLAYINY" to "PLAYING".


July 19, 2019

notes.title: Beat Warrior: Nian 1.01 Patch Notes: Update before the release
notes.content:
The game will be released on July 17. Before the release, the game was slightly modified and updated based on feedback from some test players.

1. Increased the time for operation judgment, now it is easier to hit the beat!
2. Successful judgment will display a faded small yellow circle on the UI interface.
3, modify to the default full screen, you can modify the window mode in the game.
4. Replaced the basic battle music. (The rhythm of the game is subtly stronger!)


Liujiajun
July 14, 2019
